purpose: Determine which structurally qualifying GloBI namespaces represent comparable ecological interaction sampling rather than opportunistic occurrence/specimen aggregation, before any turnover, rewiring, distance-dissimilarity, or phylogenetic response is opened.
evidence_order: source-native data documentation or methods linked by the namespace
source citation / DOI metadata only when repository documentation is insufficient

adjudication_classes.PASS_REPLICATED_ECOLOGICAL_INTERACTIONS: Documentation explicitly describes repeated ecological interaction sampling or a curated dataset whose records retain comparable site/date interaction sampling units suitable for reconstructing replicated networks.
adjudication_classes.FAIL_OCCURRENCE_SPECIMEN_AGGREGATE: Documentation identifies the namespace primarily as occurrence, specimen, collection, citizen-science, barcode, or broad aggregator data without a comparable repeated ecological interaction sampling design.
adjudication_classes.HOLD_AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE_DESIGN: Available documentation does not establish either condition without opening biological turnover outcomes.

qualification.rationale: Matches the already-frozen minimum independent source count used by the joint interaction programme; semantic filtering may reduce the 62 structural candidates but may not lower the threshold.

next_gate_if_pass: Freeze source-specific network-unit reconstruction and interaction-family semantics for semantic-PASS namespaces, then run observed-geometry informativeness before any biological turnover response.
next_gate_if_hold: Stop the primary joint interaction arm. Do not add a third primary interaction source.
